About this item

  • 12-piece color-coded knife set includes 6 knives with matching knife covers; Knives include: paring knife, utility knife, Santoku knife, carving knife, chef’s knife, and bread knife
  • Unique color-coded system for quick knife identification and to reduce the risk of cross-contamination during food preparation
  • Durable stainless-steel blades effectively hold a sharp cutting edge for safe, efficient use
  • Nonstick color coating helps prevent food from sticking to the blade for faster, easier cutting
  • Ergonomic handles promote a secure, comfortable grip; Matching blade guards protect blades and allow for safe storage in a drawer

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Colorful, Sharp, and a Great Budget Friendly Knife Set
I was impressed with this knife set, especially considering the affordable price. The bright color coding is not only fun but genuinely practical. It makes it quick and easy to grab the knife I need without having to look closely at each blade, which is a nice convenience during meal preparation. The knives arrived extremely sharp right out of the box and handled everyday kitchen tasks with ease. They also come with protective sheath covers, which I appreciate for safe drawer storage. The handles provided a secure grip and did not become slippery, even when wet. Being dishwasher safe is another feature that makes cleanup simple. The knives are lightweight, which some people may enjoy, but I personally prefer a knife with a little more weight. My only real criticism was the bread knife. The handle ergonomics did not feel as comfortable or natural in my hand as the other knives in the set. Overall, I found these knives to perform comparably to another similarly priced set I have used. If you are looking for an affordable, colorful, and sharp knife set for everyday cooking, I think this is an excellent value. They offer good performance, convenient storage with the included sheaths, and easy maintenance thanks to their dishwasher safe design.

    Overall, I’m quite happy with this knife set. I like that it offers an excellent value for the price and has been a fantastic, affordable addition to my kitchen. The color coding is a wonderful feature that not only looks fun, but also helps prevent cross-contamination while cooking. Each knife is lightweight and easy to handle, making food preparation much more efficient. I particularly appreciate the varying sizes and shapes of the knives, which accommodate a range of cutting tracks, from slicing vegetables to carving meat. The blades are sharp and have held their edge relatively well, though I do find that they require regular honing to maintain their performance. The handles are comfortable, but I wish they had a bit more grip for added safety., especially when cutting tougher ingredients. The only reason I didn’t give it a full five stars is that I would have preferred a more durable material for the blades. They are good for everyday use,. But I’m concerned about longevity with high-volume cooking. These offer an affordable price and is perfect for home cooks. If you do decide to get these, be prepared to hone them and do not expect too much and just keep in mind the price paid for these.

    I liked these knives. I bought them to have a set that I could be a little more rough with instead of messing up my premium knives.

    These are very sharp. I like that each knife comes with a sheath. They are sturdy, have a good weight and cut well. It took a long time for the edges to wear and become somewhat dull. But even still, they cut excellently.

    They’re colorful, which is fun. I throw them in the dishwasher all the time without issue. There is some minor paint loss on the two that I use most often but it doesn’t impact the effectiveness.

    The quality of the knives for the price makes these knives a low stakes, high value purchase.
